decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

JCA-0611-010-PP-GF;
JCA-0611-011-PP-2F;
JCA-0611-012-PP-3F;
JCA-0611-013-PP-RF;
JCA-0611-014-PS-AA;
JCA-0611-015-PE-FR;
JCA-0611-016-PE-RE:
JCA-0611-017-PE-NE; and
JCA-0611-018-PE-SW.

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Walls: Yellow London stock brick to match the existing building in terms of brick and mortar colour and bond pattern.

- Roof extension: Natural or artificial grey/black slates

- Windows: Timber frame sash

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - The balustrade of the Juliet balcony at fourth floor level in the west elevation (JCA-0611-016-PE-RE) hereby permitted shall be fixed flush with the rear elevation of the building at the same time as the associated doors are installed. The doors to the Juliet balconies shall open inwards only. The doors and balustrades shall be permanently retained in this form for the lifetime of the development.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 5 - The terrace hereby approved shall not be first used until the privacy screening has been installed as shown on approved drawing no. 9JCA-0611-016-PE-RE. The privacy screen shall achieve a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3 and shall have a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level of the terrace along both sides and the rear elevation. The privacy screen shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved. 

To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in terms of overlooking and privacy in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 6 - The roof of the extension and the remainder of the roof of the existing back addition other than the area shown as a terrace on the approved plans shall not be converted into or used as a terrace or other open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the remainder of the roof of the back addition or the extension hereby approved. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected around the roof and no alterations shall be carried out to the property, including the extension hereby approved, to form an access onto the roof.

Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 7 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures (excluding solar panels and air source heat pumps) shall be erected upon the roof of the extension hereby permitted. 

It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, contrary to Policies DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Erection of an additional floor at roof level, including the installation of French doors and a Juliette balcony to the rear elevation; installation of a 1.7 metre high obscured glazed privacy screen around part of the flat roof of the existing three storey back addition at third floor level, in connection with its use as a roof terrace; installation of a door in the rear elevation at third floor level to provide access to the proposed roof terrace; installation of 3no openable. rooflights to replace the existing 2no. rooflights to the sloping roof of the existing side extension at ground floor level; and replacement of the French doors and window to the rear elevation at ground floor level with a new enlarged opening with metal framed glass doors and windows.
